## The three constraints

- [ ] No new dependency, no build step, no package.json.
- [ ] No backend. Everything still runs in the visitor's browser.
- [ ] No tracking, analytics, or third party script.

## Manual test pass

- [ ] Search works and suggestions appear as you type.
- [ ] Two extensions at once keep separate version and platform controls.
- [ ] An older version changes the download link.
- [ ] A multi platform extension such as `ms-vscode.cpptools` shows the platform menu.
- [ ] A pasted marketplace URL resolves.
- [ ] Browser console is clean.
- [ ] No sideways scroll at phone width.
- [ ] Light and dark mode both look right.
